name: adiaz-claude-plugins
description: Solo-founder product-discovery toolkit: idea-hunt surfaces defensible product ideas from free public web signals; market-research evaluates commercial viability via a six-phase methodology.

plugins.name: idea-hunt
plugins.description: Slash command that scans free public web sources (HN, GitHub, Reddit, IH, YC RFS, Product Hunt) and surfaces one ranked software-product idea per run with cited evidence. No paid APIs.

plugins.name: market-research
plugins.description: Six-phase methodology for evaluating commercial viability of digital products. Calibrated for solo founder context. Seven slash commands for phase invocation, seven subagents for adapted prompt execution.

Disciplined, evidence-based knowledge management for reverse-engineering and research projects. Where a file lives tells you how much to trust it: provisional work in active/, facts verified by DIRECT evidence in docs/truth/ (the 'Wall'), finished investigations as chronicles in docs/history/. You work in 'campaigns' (open -> investigate -> delegate to subagents -> review against the Wall -> promote what's proven -> close into a chronicle), with an optional lifecycle for hiring external AI agents as research drafters. /init-project drops the structure into any repo.
